policy: A trustworthy official government consolidated text may be accepted as a direct source reference within its displayed version, language, status and date scope. Full Gazette-chain reconstruction and a retained local conversion are not blanket prerequisites. Acceptance of an external link is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic adequacy and country completion.
